description:
Always-on presence app for remote teams

Hiroba is an open-source, always-on presence app for remote teams. See who is around on a shared 2D floor, walk over for spatial voice, or page a teammate directly. Voice is WebRTC peer-to-peer, so audio never passes through the server. Use the hosted edition or self-host the Rust server.
Desktop installers for Hiroba v0.1.36.
After installing, open an invite link or point the app at your server.
Server self-hosting: docs/SELF_HOSTING.md
What's Changed
- feat: a bulletin board in every space by @DaisukeYoda in #9
- feat(client): label the bulletin board and badge its note count by @DaisukeYoda in #10
